audience_name: Lean ecommerce/Shopify support team scaling order volume without hiring

dossier.audience_name: Lean ecommerce/Shopify support team scaling order volume without hiring
dossier.orientation: Help Scout is a shared-inbox help desk whose AI Answers tries to resolve repetitive customer questions from Docs and other knowledge sources before they reach an agent, handing off to a human when needed.

setup_conditions: Maintain a Docs knowledge base as the source AI Answers draws on (E23, E17)
Install Beacon on the site for in-app AI Answers with human handoff (E23, E17)
Approve, edit or decline Suggested Improvements to raise answer accuracy over time (E27)
decision_gaps: Does Help Scout's Shopify integration display live order, shipping and refund data in the conversation sidebar, and can AI Answers read it?
What does Help Scout count as one billable unit for AI Answers (a resolution, a conversation, or each AI reply) at this team size?
Shopify (or similar) integration that pulls order-status, shipping and refund data into the inbox sidebar

unverified_requirement_basis.Shopify (or similar) integration that pu: "order-status, shipping, and refund questions pulled into the inbox sidebar via Shopify integration"

defining_need_fit.caveat: The selected evidence documents deflection of common questions from Docs plus a shared queue with behind-the-scenes collaboration and human handoff, but Shopify order-data lookup in the sidebar and VIP routing are not established by the selected evidence.
defining_need_fit.why: Components of the stated need (knowledge-base deflection, instant answers, human handoff, shared queue) are documented, while the two Shopify-specific and VIP-routing components are unestablished, so the whole need stays partial.

ranked_relevance.why: A dated, numeric deflection outcome (peaking at 15.46% in August 2025) is the closest licensed proof that AI Answers removes repetitive volume.
States the mechanism behind deflection: instant in-app answers inside Beacon drawing on Docs and other knowledge sources with a smooth handoff to a human.
Documents AI Answers handling common questions instantly plus workflow automations in a retail/ecommerce bike shop, the nearest licensed analogue to this audience.
Shows AI-handled volume growing from 36 to nearly 300 conversations per week, i.e.
Suggested Improvements describes how answer accuracy is maintained with one-click approve/edit/decline, the upkeep cost of the deflection mechanism.
Improvements lets a lean team add missing context from a conversation without rewriting help articles, which bears on who maintains the knowledge base.
Describes the shared queue with customer context, behind-the-scenes collaboration and follow-through, the documented half of handling complex cases.
A customer's own vendor comparison is not independently verified and would assert unsupported superiority over named rivals.

problem_fits.caveat: The documented deflection draws on Docs and other knowledge sources; answering "where's my order" from live Shopify order data is not established by the selected evidence, and the 15.46% figure comes from a church-software company, not a DTC merchant.
problem_fits.why: AI Answers demonstrably deflects common repeat questions at a measured rate, but order-status answers specifically depend on order data whose availability is unestablished here.

problem_fits.caveat: No pricing, plan, billing-unit or overage fact appears in the selected evidence.
problem_fits.why: The cost-per-ticket and billing-unit question cannot be answered from the selected ledger at all.

segment_objections.objection: Can it actually answer "where's my order" by reading my Shopify order data, or only repeat what's in my help docs?
Your deflection proof comes from a church software vendor; does this hold for a DTC store's order and shipping questions?
segment_objections.answer: The nearest licensed ecommerce case is a bike shop running Docs, two Beacons and four inboxes where AI Answers handles common questions instantly, though no deflection rate is published for it.

silences.reason: The selected evidence contains no price, plan tier or definition of a billable unit, so the merchants' cost-per-ticket comparison cannot be addressed.
silences.question: What is Help Scout's published price for AI Answers and what does it count as one billable unit?

evidence.claim: Help Scout's shared inbox gives all teammates access to the queue, letting them see customer context, collaborate behind the scenes, and follow conversations to resolution.
evidence.verbatim: Help Scout’s shared inbox makes that easy. All teammates have access to the queue and can see customer context, collaborate behind the scenes, and follow conversations to resolution.

evidence.claim: The New Wheel now manages four inboxes across teams and locations, runs two Beacons on their site, and maintains a Docs knowledge base for self-service.
evidence.verbatim: They now manage four inboxes across teams and locations, run two Beacons on their site, and maintain a rich Docs knowledge base for self-service.

evidence.claim: AI Answers handles common customer questions instantly, and workflow automations help the team stay organized and responsive.
evidence.verbatim: AI Answers handles common questions instantly, while workflow automations help their team stay organized and responsive.

evidence.claim: Luke evaluated other AI vendors — Zoom, Maven, and Intercom — and found those bolt-on tools required major process changes, whereas AI Answers lives inside Help Scout where the team already works.
evidence.verbatim: After weighing various AI vendors like Zoom, Maven, and Intercom, Luke found those bolt-on tools required major process changes. AI Answers stood out because it lives where the team already works, in Help Scout.

context.subject: AI Answers vs Zoom, Maven, Intercom
context.limitations: Rival claim attributed to customer's evaluation, not independently verified.

evidence.claim: Inside Beacon, AI Answers provides instant, in-app answers with a smooth handoff to a human when needed, drawing on Docs and other knowledge sources, and can be instantly improved with suggestions from recent email conversations.
evidence.verbatim: Inside Beacon, AI Answers provides instant, in-app answers with a smooth handoff to a human when needed. It draws on Docs and other knowledge sources, can be instantly improved with suggestions from recent email conversations, and captures eCatholic’s friendly, approachable tone to stay on-brand.

evidence.claim: eCatholic's AI Answers handled 36 conversations in the first week of use, growing to nearly 300 per week by August 2025.
evidence.verbatim: What began with 36 conversations handled in the first week has now grown to nearly 300 per week by August.

evidence.claim: eCatholic's deflection rate, which Luke once hoped might reach 10%, climbed past that, peaking at 15.46% in August 2025.
evidence.verbatim: Their deflection rate, which Luke once hoped might reach 10%, has consistently climbed past that mark, peaking at 15.46% in August 2025, their highest yet.

evidence.claim: With Improvements, teams can quickly add missing context right from a conversation without rewriting help articles, and Help Scout's AI learns directly from that feedback to make the next answer more accurate and on-brand.
evidence.verbatim: With Improvements, Luke’s team can quickly add missing context right from a conversation. There’s no need to rewrite help articles. Help Scout’s AI learns directly from that feedback, which means the next answer is more accurate and on-brand.

evidence.claim: With Suggested Improvements, the system surfaces pre-drafted updates that the team can approve, edit, or decline with a click, improving AI Answers' accuracy with minimal effort.
evidence.verbatim: With Suggested Improvements, the system does even more of the work itself, surfacing pre-drafted updates. The team can approve, edit, or decline those suggestions with a click, making sure AI Answers is more accurate with minimal effort.
